label: Access
description: What the edge asks of access: sign in against one of two directories, refresh, sign out, read and keep preferences, deliver a challenge code -- and the four decisions the policies fire. Bound by access.binding.json.

signInCustomer.description: Verify a customer's credential and issue our token, realm customer.

signInEmployee.description: Verify an employee's credential and issue our token, realm employee, roles from the directory's groups.

refresh.description: Trade a refresh token for a new pair. Refuses as invalid_refresh when it is unknown, spent or expired.

savePreferences.description: Keep a theme in the caller's session; answers the attributes whole.

deliverCode.description: Give an open challenge its code and hand it over. Refuses as unknown_challenge when the challenge is unknown or expired.

id.description: the challenge id the caller was told

requireSignedIn.description: Allow any caller our token names; refuse anonymous otherwise.

requireEmployee.description: Allow a caller of realm employee; refuse anonymous or forbidden.

requireRegistrar.description: Allow a caller holding the registrar role; refuse anonymous or forbidden.

requireOtp.description: Allow a caller who answered a challenge on this call; refuse otp otherwise, which the policy turns into a challenge.
